quarterly_data.signal: Rocket Lab 10-Q: revenue for the six months ended June 30, 2026 was $434,414 thousand, up 63% from $267,067 thousand (Launch Services $108,249 thousand, Space Systems $326,165 thousand), with a six-month gross margin of 37.1%; capital expenditures were $53.1 million for the six months.
quarterly_data.figure: six-month revenue $434,414 thousand (+63%); gross margin 37.1%; capex $53.1 million

quarterly_data.signal: Rocket Lab 10-Q: backlog increased from $1,847.3 million at December 31, 2025 to $2,355.9 million at June 30, 2026 ($1,415.8 million space systems, $940.2 million launch services), mainly from continued bookings and backlog added through acquisitions (GEOST, Mynaric and Motiv); contract liabilities rose to $351,193 thousand, including $76,015 thousand assumed at acquisitions. The filing's customer concentration lists a government customer at 42% and MDA Corporation at 11% of accounts receivable (six months ended June 30, 2026).
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $2,355.9 million; contract liabilities $351,193 thousand; government customer 42%; MDA Corporation 11%
